short: The left side of a journal entry, recorded as Dr.
seoTitle: Debit Entry — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A debit entry is the left-hand side of a double-entry transaction, written as Dr. In your own books, cash coming in is a debit.
definition: A debit entry is the left-hand side of a double-entry transaction, written as Dr. Debits increase assets and expenses and decrease liabilities, income and equity — it is a direction, not a judgement about good or bad.
bodyHtml:
Why Debit Entry matters

Most bookkeeping confusion starts with debits, largely because a bank statement uses the word from the bank's point of view rather than yours. In your own books, cash coming in is a debit.

How Debit Entry works in practice

Learn the rule by account type rather than memorising cases: assets and expenses increase with debits, everything else increases with credits. Every entry needs debits equal to credits.

Worked example

Paying ₹5,000 rent debits the rent expense account and credits the bank account.

faq.question: Why does my bank statement call a withdrawal a debit?
faq.answer: Because it is written from the bank's books, where your deposit is their liability. In your books the signs are reversed.

faq.question: Is a debit always an increase?
faq.answer: Only for assets and expenses. For liabilities, income and equity a debit is a decrease.
